services.name: Escape Rooms
services.desc: If you’re looking for something to do in Calgary that’s not the same old thing, an escape room date tends to deliver. You’re doing something together, not just sitting across from each other. You’re figuring things out in real time. And whatever happens in that room, you’ll have a story to tell by the time you leave. There’s something revealing about watching someone solve a puzzle. How they think, what they notice first, whether they go quiet under pressure or get louder - it comes out. Escape rooms are surprisingly good at that. For new couples, it’s one of the best icebreakers in Calgary. You’re not staring at a menu trying to think of interesting things to say. You’re already doing

blurb: Escape Ops provides five original escape rooms built from scratch, designed for first-timers and veterans alike. Each room offers a unique theme and puzzle experience lasting 60 minutes. The venue is suitable for team building, birthday parties, date nights, and corporate events, accommodating groups large and small.
extraNote: Participants must sign a liability waiver before playing · No catering, party rooms, or event spaces offered · Indoor, climate-controlled venue, suitable year-round
